claims.text: adjacent to the southeast corner of Central Park

description.value: Apple Fifth Avenue sits on the General Motors Building plaza, where Wikipedia describes a transparent 32 ft (9.8 m) cube adjacent to the southeast corner of Central Park. Apple's 2019 press release says the rebuilt store is nearly double the size, with a Forum that hosts free, daily Today at Apple programming, and it remains the only Apple retail location open 24 hours a day, 365 days a year. Apple's store page lists Genius Bar by appointment for repairs. On Yelp it holds 3.4 (1.2k reviews); reviewers single out riding the glass elevator down into the store and note that the Geniuses were super helpful and sweet. The watch-outs are crowds and waits: one Reddit commenter says it is often really crowded during normal hours, and a 2019 Tripadvisor reviewer spent ½ hour in the pickup line.
